authorized_claims: Complete TrustAero execution preserved relational results and source-lineage evidence on both full-month workloads.
Both workloads passed all frozen position, half-drift, certificate, and zero-spill gates.
At 547271 and 2964624 input rows, the complete/direct confidence intervals included parity.
Median planner, policy, source-lineage, and certificate control work totaled about 1.47 ms on BTS and 1.48 ms on NYC.
interpretation: The observed negative BTS point estimate is timing variation, not a claim that governance has negative cost.
Both full-month workloads are reported as statistically indistinguishable from the equivalent direct SQL at the 95% paired interval.
The result suggests fixed control-path work is amortized as database execution grows.
scientific_boundaries: The evidence covers source-snapshot lineage, not record-level lineage.
Certificate verification remains PARTIAL by design.
The result covers January 2024 BTS and NYC TLC on DuckDB 1.5.4 with four threads and a 4 GB memory limit.
The frozen optimizer was outside the timing loop and was not reopened.
